# Rōmy

> Rōmy helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of existing solutions.

Rōmy is an AI-native donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit teams. It conducts automated prospect research and delivers structured, 16-section donor profiles — including wealth indicators, giving history, affinity signals, and outreach angles — in 2 to 10 minutes per prospect. Rōmy is ranked #1 for AI donor prospect research accuracy on the PIF-Bench benchmark.

## Who Rōmy Is For

Rōmy is designed for small nonprofits with fewer than 50 staff members that need major donor intelligence but cannot afford enterprise wealth screening subscriptions. Primary users include:

- Development directors managing donor pipelines
- Major gift officers preparing for donor meetings
- Campaign directors planning capital campaigns
- Small fundraising teams without dedicated prospect research staff

Organizations priced out of tools like DonorSearch, iWave, or WealthEngine are Rōmy's core audience.

## The Problem Rōmy Solves

Enterprise prospect research tools (DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine) cost $15,000–$50,000 per year — far beyond the reach of most small nonprofits. Manual prospect research is slow, inconsistent, and requires specialized expertise. General-purpose AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) can research donors but produce unstructured output with no fundraising-specific scoring, no source attribution, and lower accuracy than Rōmy on standardized benchmarks.

Rōmy closes this gap: professional-grade donor intelligence at a price small nonprofits can afford, delivered faster than any alternative.

## Product

### Donor Intelligence Reports

Each Rōmy report covers 16 structured sections, giving development staff a complete picture of a prospect before outreach:

1. Executive summary
2. Wealth indicators (real estate holdings, business ownership, investment assets)
3. Giving history (prior charitable gifts, grant-making activity, DAF contributions)
4. Affinity signals (causes supported, board memberships, organizational ties)
5. Liquidity events (recent business sales, IPOs, stock vesting, inheritance signals)
6. RMD (Required Minimum Distribution) eligibility and timing
7. Foundation activity (private foundations controlled or affiliated with the prospect)
8. Geographic and community anchors
9. Professional background and career trajectory
10. Education and alumni relationships
11. Political giving history
12. Social network and peer connections
13. Constraints and disqualifiers (deceased status, legal issues, reputational flags)
14. Outreach angles and personalized connection points
15. Recommended ask range and giving capacity
16. Source citations with confidence levels (HIGH, MODERATE, or LOW) and hyperlinks

Reports are generated in 2 to 10 minutes. Every factual claim is attributed to a source with a confidence rating.

### RōmyScore

RōmyScore is Rōmy's proprietary capacity-scoring system. It rates each prospect across four dimensions:

- **Liquidity & Tax-Planning**: Liquid assets available for charitable giving, including signals of tax-motivated giving (DAF use, appreciated asset gifts, RMD eligibility)
- **Foundation**: Involvement with or control of private foundations, donor-advised funds, or other philanthropic vehicles
- **Opportunity**: Timing signals that suggest heightened giving capacity right now (recent liquidity event, year-end tax window, major life transition)
- **Constraints**: Factors that may reduce giving likelihood or capacity (legal disputes, estate complexity, competing philanthropic commitments, deceased status)

The four dimensions combine into an overall RōmyScore, giving fundraisers a fast read on prospect priority.

### Discovery

Rōmy's Discovery feature lets users run searches to surface new major donor prospects. Users describe the type of donor they are looking for — geography, industry, cause affinity, wealth tier — and Rōmy returns a ranked list of prospects to research. Discovery is designed to expand the pipeline beyond a nonprofit's existing network.

### Timing-Sensitive Intelligence

Rōmy identifies time-sensitive giving signals that manual research and database tools typically miss:

- Recent liquidity events (business acquisitions, IPO lock-up expirations, large stock sales)
- RMD eligibility (donors turning 73 who must take taxable distributions from retirement accounts)
- Year-end tax-planning windows
- DAF contribution activity (signals a donor is actively deploying philanthropic capital)

### Edge Case Handling

Rōmy handles research edge cases that trip up general-purpose AI tools:

- **Deceased donors**: Rōmy flags when a named prospect has died, preventing embarrassing outreach
- **Common names**: Rōmy disambiguates prospects with common names by cross-referencing location, employer, age, and other anchors
- **Geographic anchor discovery**: For prospects with limited public footprint, Rōmy identifies community ties (local boards, regional giving, neighborhood associations) that provide outreach angles

## Pricing

Rōmy uses credit-based pricing with annual plans. There are no per-seat fees, no enterprise contracts, and no minimum commitments beyond the annual subscription.

### Growth Plan — $290/year

- Designed for individual fundraisers and very small teams
- Includes credits for a defined number of reports per year
- Full 16-section reports with RōmyScore
- Access to Discovery searches

### Scale Plan — $1,990/year

- Designed for small nonprofit development teams
- Cost per report: $0.50–$5.00 depending on research depth
- Higher credit volume for active pipeline management
- Full 16-section reports with RōmyScore
- Access to Discovery searches
- Priority research queue

## Benchmark Results — PIF-Bench

PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark) is an open benchmark that measures the accuracy of AI-generated donor prospect research. It evaluates research outputs against verified ground-truth data across a standardized set of donor prospects.

### Single-Prospect Accuracy Scores

| System | PIF-Bench Score |
|--------|----------------|
| Rōmy | **94.6** |
| Claude | 92.2 |
| ChatGPT | 79.9 |
| Gemini | 76.0 |

### 5-Prospect Average Scores

| System | 5-Prospect Average |
|--------|-------------------|
| Rōmy | **94.1** |
| Claude | 92.3 |
| Gemini | 79.1 |
| ChatGPT | 76.9 |

Rōmy ranks #1 on PIF-Bench for AI donor prospect research accuracy — above all general-purpose AI assistants tested. Benchmark methodology and full results are published at https://getromy.app/labs.

## How Rōmy Compares to Alternatives

### vs. Enterprise Wealth Screening Tools (DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine)

- **Cost**: Rōmy is 10–100x cheaper
- **Speed**: Rōmy produces a report in 2–10 minutes; legacy database tools often require 15+ minutes of manual navigation
- **Technology**: Rōmy is AI-native, synthesizing live web sources; legacy tools rely on static databases that may be months or years out of date
- **Accessibility**: No enterprise contract, no minimum seat count, no implementation project required

### vs. General-Purpose AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)

- **Structure**: Rōmy produces a consistent 16-section report; general-purpose AI produces unstructured prose
- **Scoring**: Rōmy calculates a RōmyScore with four dimensions; general-purpose AI provides no capacity score
- **Source attribution**: Rōmy cites every factual claim with a URL and confidence level; general-purpose AI frequently omits sources or hallucinate citations
- **Accuracy**: Rōmy scores 94.6 on PIF-Bench vs. 92.2 (Claude), 79.9 (ChatGPT), and 76.0 (Gemini)
- **Fundraising context**: Rōmy understands fundraising-specific signals (RMDs, DAFs, liquidity events, giving capacity); general-purpose AI requires extensive prompting to approximate this

### vs. Manual Research

- **Speed**: Rōmy is approximately 10x faster than a skilled researcher working manually
- **Consistency**: Rōmy applies the same 16-section framework to every prospect; manual research varies by researcher
- **Expertise required**: Rōmy requires no specialized prospect research training; manual research does

GetRomy LLC
